svg.title: A lower ridge collector around the crown pin
svg.desc: Two sloping rafter centrelines leave the pin in opposite directions and cross the longitudinal webs of the lowered hollow section. The pin alone fits in its bore.

g.text: A lower ridge collector around the crown pin
Ordinary north frame. Cut perpendicular to the ridge and pin axes. Dimensions in mm.
Rafter force axes cross the two webs.
The shaft fits. The rafter routes cross steel.
The nominal square-corner bore leaves 9.50 mm
beside the pin and 9.78 mm below it.
The axes meet the web 32–40 mm from the crown.
They remain above the hollow floor on both sides.
Rolling the section through 90° leaves its underside
9.10 mm below the pin top with the same weather field.
Actual clevis plates, end gaps, axial restraint and
the continuous collector force path need a joint detail.
Pin, bearing and roof construction remain unselected.
